23andMe | Software Engineer II, Compute Pipelines | Palo Alto, CA | Hybrid or Remote (US) | Full-time | Bay Area Rate: $150k–$190k

The Compute Pipelines team processes population-scale genetic data powering features like Ancestry Composition, DNA Relatives, and health risk prediction.

Looking for someone with:

- Deep hands-on Python: pipelines, services, libraries

- Infrastructure as code (Terraform on AWS, Docker)

- Experience debugging distributed systems at scale

- 4+ years industry experience, BS CS or equivalent

Small high-trust team, real ownership, AI-friendly. Scientists in computational biology and population genetics embedded on the team.

Apply: https://23andme.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/23/job/Palo-Alto...
